editorialPolicy: AARAMORA is a multilingual discovery catalogue. It links to official sources and records language scope, access model, provenance, accessibility notes and item-level rights caveats. It does not mirror copyrighted books, scrape restricted sites, bypass access controls or treat a collection-level statement as a book-level licence. Language filters are discovery aids, not a guarantee that a linked source contains every listed language. Every edition-level record carries an explicit review state. A source page check is not a native-language, clinical, religious/cultural, legal or assistive-technology approval.
